reviews.text: I first reached out to Daniel regarding ordering a Father's Day gift for my husband on 5/29. On 5/31 the design was finalized and I received an email notification on 6/1 that the FedEx label was created & it gave me an eta of May 5-6. Needless to say its now 6/12 & still no movement. I have asked for my money back because I am forced to by something else. Although Daniel has been very responsive, its very hard when trying to determine if this is a scam or something out of his control. I understand these are custom items but with no movement of the item & knowing it not going to arrive on time or at all, I just want my refund. Please do the right thing.
